exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "That Kind of [Noun]".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! そんな (sonna) + Noun matches "That Kind of [Noun]".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is そんな (sonna) + Noun.
exercises.explanation: Used before nouns to mean "that kind of" or "such a" thing near the listener.
